maps.name: Warsong Gulch

meta.goal: Capture the enemy flag and bring it to your base 3 times first

brief: prio
Always track the enemy flag carrier and kill them with a two-way pincer at a chokepoint.
pos
You can only score while your flag is at your base, so the carrier holds at base until your flag is returned.
tb
When both flags are held, carriers get Focused Assault and Brutal Assault, increasing damage taken and reducing healing taken.
tb
In Blitz, carrier debuffs stack every 15 seconds, twice as fast as normal.
tip
In Blitz matches with no tanks, healer and DPS carriers get Empowered Carrier.
pos
Grab the Speed buff in the base tunnel right at the start so the enemy carrier can't use it.
tip
When the carrier dies, a teammate picks up the dropped flag and keeps running. If an enemy clicks it, it returns to their base.

detail.overview: Warsong Gulch is a capture-the-flag battleground where each side steals the other's flag. Bring the enemy flag back to your flag spot to score; first to 3 captures wins. You can't score while the enemy holds your flag, so the core fight is killing their carrier to recover it.

sections.title: Victory Conditions
points: [참고] Bring the enemy flag to your base's flag spot to score. Your flag must be at your base.
[참고] While both flags are held, neither side can score.
[참고] After a capture, both flags return to their spots after 20 seconds.
[참고] When time runs out, the team with more captures wins. On a tie, the team that scored last wins.
@b [참고] Blitz matches last up to 12 minutes.

sections.title: Opening Setup
points: [분담] At the start, the carrier heads to the enemy flag room while everyone else wins the teamfight so enemies respawn separately.
[분담] If a stealthed enemy skips the teamfight, suspect an ambush in the enemy flag room and send an escort with the carrier.
[위치] Grab the Speed buff in the base tunnel right at the start.

sections.title: Flag Carrying Rules
points: [참고] The flag drops if the carrier dies, mounts, stealths, or uses certain immunities.
[참고] A teammate can pick up a dropped flag and keep running. If an enemy clicks it, it returns to base immediately.
[참고] The player who dropped the flag can't pick it up again for 3 seconds.
[탱버] When both flags are held, carriers stack Focused Assault and Brutal Assault, increasing damage taken and reducing healing taken.
[참고] When both flags return to base, the debuff timer resets.
@b [탱버] In Blitz, carrier debuffs stack once every 15 seconds.
@b [참고] In Blitz matches with no tanks, healer and DPS carriers get Empowered Carrier, increasing max health and movement speed.

sections.title: Offense and Defense
points: [분담] Once the teamfight is over and your carrier is safe, split into defense and offense groups.
@r [분담] Defense: the carrier, two healers, and one or two DPS with slows and utility.
@r [분담] Offense: the third healer and the remaining DPS.
[우선 처치] The enemy carrier often goes up to the roof, which has many escape routes. Find them before you commit.
[위치] Don't chase the enemy carrier in a single line. Pincer them from two directions at a chokepoint.
[분담] With 1-2 minutes left, if the enemy leads on last capture and only defends, everyone except the carrier goes on offense.
[위치] Late in the game, the carrier stands on the capture point and scores the instant your flag returns.

sections.title: Buffs
points: [참고] Each side has one Berserking building and one Restoration building.
[참고] Berserking increases damage dealt by 30% but also increases damage taken by 10%.
[참고] Restoration restores health and mana, and breaks when you attack or are attacked.

tank: [분담] Tanks can carry the flag. In Blitz, tanks are only matched against tanks.
@b [참고] In Blitz matches with tanks, Empowered Carrier is not applied.
[분담] If you suspect an ambush, don't grab the flag right away. Call teammates first, then take it.
[위치] While carrying, hold on the roof side, which has more escape routes.
healer: @b [분담] In Blitz, healers are often the best flag carriers.
@b [분담] Healers who aren't carrying should mostly play defense.
@r [분담] Two healers join the defense group, the third joins offense.
@r [위치] When the second healer joins offense, go back as soon as the enemy offense arrives.
[참고] Since patch 12.1, healing received in battlegrounds is reduced by 20%.
dps: @b [분담] DPS lean toward offense, but leave one or two on defense to protect the carrier.
@b [위치] As soon as the enemy carrier grabs the flag, go on offense and cut them off in the middle of the map.
[위치] Don't chase the enemy carrier in a single line. Pincer them from two directions at a chokepoint.
[제어] Wait on the lower floor for the enemy carrier to jump down from above, then CC them.

detail.overview: Temple of Kotmogu is a resource battleground where you hold orbs from the temple's four corners. You score while holding an orb, more the closer you are to the center, and kills also give points. The longer you hold an orb, the more damage the carrier deals and takes, and the less healing they receive.

sections.title: Orb Rules
points: [참고] Four orbs (green, blue, purple, orange) sit in the temple's four corners.
[참고] Each player can hold only one orb and can't mount while holding it.
[참고] When a carrier dies, the orb returns to its starting spot.
[탱버] The longer you hold an Orb of Power, the more damage you deal and take, and the less healing you receive.
[참고] The temple center gives the most points, the surrounding courtyard a bit less, and outside the temple even less.
[참고] The ledge around the center marks the border between the center and outer zones.
[참고] Killing enemies also gives points.
@b [참고] In Blitz, points earned in the center zone are increased.

sections.title: Opening and Strategy
points: @r [분담] Don't grab orbs right at the start. Win the teamfight so enemies respawn separately, then grab them.
@r [위치] Rather than holding the center, rotate around its outer edge and pick off enemies who push forward.
@b [분담] Points rise fast in Blitz, so everyone, including healers, should be ready to grab an orb.
@b [교대] If the carrier is about to die, the next carrier should already be near the orb spot.
[위치] When fighting in the center, spread out so AoE stuns and CC don't hit several of you.
[회피] If you'd die soon holding an orb alone, don't grab it. Kill enemy carriers with your team instead.
[참고] Holding all four orbs for about 50 seconds gives a big score boost and higher gains afterward.

sections.title: Respawns and Buffs
points: [참고] Using a line splitting the map north to south: die on the east side and you respawn at the west graveyard, die on the west side and you respawn at the east graveyard.
[참고] Berserking spawns between the orange and purple orbs and between the blue and green orbs, respawning every 2 minutes.
[참고] Four Restoration buffs sit near the north and south entrances, respawning every 2 minutes.

tank: [분담] Players with good mobility and defensives should carry orbs.
[위치] When holding an orb, stay behind your team and pull out immediately if in danger.
[회피] Don't grab an orb if you'd die soon alone. If you die, the enemy gets points.
healer: @r [분담] Healers shouldn't hold orbs, except when only a few points are left at the end.
@b [분담] In Blitz, healers should also be ready to grab orbs.
[생존기] Don't waste healing cooldowns on carriers whose healing received is heavily reduced from holding the orb a long time.
[생존기] Use healing cooldowns for pushes or on carriers who just picked up an orb.
[참고] Since patch 12.1, healing received in battlegrounds is reduced by 20%.
dps: [분담] DPS with good mobility and defensives are the first-choice carriers.
[우선 처치] Focus enemy carriers weakened from holding the orb a long time first.
@b [위치] Ranged DPS stand at the edges to reach respawning orb spots quickly.
@b [위치] Melee DPS push into the center, but don't go too deep without defensives.

detail.overview: Eye of the Storm combines Arathi Basin-style base control with Warsong Gulch-style flag carrying. Holding the four corner bases gathers resources, and bringing the center flag to one of your bases gives bonus points based on how many bases you hold. Falling into the void between bases kills you.

sections.title: Rules
points: [참고] The more bases you hold, the faster resources accumulate.
[참고] Carry the center Netherstorm Flag to one of your bases to score. The more bases you hold, the more points per capture.
[참고] If the flag carrier dies, the flag drops and anyone can pick it up. If no one picks it up for a while, it returns to the center.
@r [참고] In Rated, you capture a base by clicking its flag, and taking damage interrupts the cast.
@r [참고] In Rated, rocks around the center flag prevent knockbacks.
[회피] Falling into the void between bases kills you.
@b [참고] Since patch 12.0, all four bases are always active in Blitz too. The old rule of alternating two bases at a time is gone.
@b [참고] Blitz Swift Pursuit increases mount speed by 100%, plus another 50% on bridges starting 30 seconds into the match.

sections.title: Opening Setup
points: @r [분담] At the start, leave one player on each of your two bases and send the rest to the center flag.
@r [분담] If the enemy has three or more stealth classes, don't leave players who can't hold alone as base defenders.
@r [분담] Base defenders call out enemy count and roles immediately when attacked.
[분담] When a base is attacked, send someone with good mobility to help. If the teamfight is nearly over, you can send a healer.

sections.title: Strategy
points: [위치] In the center, keep your back to the rocks so you don't get knocked off.
@r [분담] If you keep losing the center teamfight, send stealth DPS to an enemy base to CC the defenders and cap it or bait out their trinket.
[분담] Once you take a third base, peel off right away to secure it, and leave a few in the center to keep fighting for the flag.
[위치] Right after taking a base, the enemy often counterattacks the farthest diagonal base, so don't pour everyone into the third base.
[제어] Even with three bases, letting the enemy flag carrier run free without slows or CC lets them catch up.
[참고] Each base spawns combat buffs in rotation, respawning every 1 minute 30 seconds.

tank: @r [분담] As a base defender, call out enemy count and roles immediately when attacked.
[위치] In the center, keep your back to the rocks so knockbacks don't send you off the edge.
[분담] When a base is attacked, peel off quickly to help.
healer: [분담] If the teamfight is nearly over or several enemies hit a base, the healer goes to help while DPS keep up the pressure.
[위치] Don't get pushed to the edge by knockbacks or grips in the center teamfight.
@r [분담] When a base defender calls an attack, decide who helps based on enemy count.

@r [분담] Stealth DPS sneak to an enemy base, CC the defenders, and go for the cap.
[제어] Lock down the enemy flag carrier with slows and CC.
[위치] Knock enemies near the edge into the void.

detail.overview: Silvershard Mines is a resource battleground about controlling carts that leave the center and move along tracks. Outnumber the enemy inside a cart's circle to take it and gain resources gradually; deliver it while you control it for a big resource payout. There are three tracks, and up to three carts move at once.

sections.title: Cart Rules
points: [참고] The side with more players inside the cart circle controls it. With equal numbers, it doesn't move.
[참고] With only your team present, several players flip it at the same speed as one.
[참고] Outnumbering the enemy by one flips it as fast as outnumbering them by three or four.
[회피] Dying inside the cart circle instantly swings it hard toward the enemy, so die outside the circle.
[참고] A controlled cart gives small amounts of resources until it arrives, then a large payout on arrival.
[참고] After a cart arrives, a new one spawns in the center shortly after.
[참고] You can switch tracks by clicking the junction lever, and you don't need to control the cart to do it.

sections.title: Opening Setup
points: @r [분담] The small group goes to the middle or top cart; everyone else fights at the lava cart.
@r [분담] The main group at the lava cart holds as long as possible even when losing. If it collapses, the enemy breaks off and takes the small group's cart too.
@r [분담] If the main group is confident in the teamfight, all 10 fight at the lava cart, kill the enemy, then the small group peels off to take the top cart.
@b [분담] Hold the lava cart while a small group steadily takes the middle cart. It's easy to move between the two.
@b [분담] Build the small group from two DPS and one healer.

sections.title: Strategy
points: [분담] As a cart nears its destination, count players on both sides and don't overcommit to one spot.
[참고] The top cart is easy for the enemy to slow you at, making it hard to escape. Only send several players when it's a sure thing.
[참고] You can switch tracks for the top and lava carts, but it's not recommended unless the enemy keeps taking the lava cart.
[위치] Knocking enemies into the water from the north bridge buys time.
[위치] Knockbacks from the high point of the uphill track send enemies farther.
@b [분담] When one more cart wins the game, all 8 push the last cart together.
[참고] Restoration is near the middle and lava destinations; Berserking is near the top track junction and near the lava cart's northeast track destination.

tank: @r [분담] A tank can hold a cart alone as the small group.
[회피] Don't die inside the cart circle. If you're about to die, step out.
[위치] Hold inside the circle and push enemies out of it.
healer: @b [분담] A healer with good mobility runs the small group and rotates between carts.
[위치] Stand inside the cart circle to fill numbers, but don't die in it.
[분담] The small group's healer calls for teammates so you don't fall behind in numbers until the cart arrives.
[참고] Since patch 12.1, healing received in battlegrounds is reduced by 20%.
dps: [분담] DPS with good survivability and CC run the small group and contest carts.
[제어] When numbers are even, CC enemies or push them out of the circle to flip the cart.
[위치] Knock enemies off bridges and uphill tracks to buy time.
[분담] If you win the middle cart early, DPS with good mobility peel off to take the top cart too.

detail.overview: Battle for Gilneas is a resource battleground fought over three bases: Lighthouse, Waterworks, and Mines. The more bases you hold, the faster resources build, and holding a base also lets you use its nearby graveyard. The team that holds two bases longest usually wins.

sections.title: Rules
points: [참고] Click a base's white flag to start capturing. Hold it for a set time and it becomes yours and starts generating resources.
[참고] Taking damage during the capture cast interrupts it.
[참고] Two bases generate resources much faster than one, so you can come back even when behind.
@b [참고] In Blitz, the flag capture cast is shortened to 4 seconds and the center base gives more resources.
[참고] Since patch 12.0, a new bridge to Waterworks was added and the broken bridge was repaired, so both sides have similar access.

sections.title: Opening Setup

@b [분담] Stealth or pet classes make good starting base defenders.
@r [분담] If the enemy sends a small group to your starting base, spot it early and split players between the two bases.
[분담] If enemy stealth classes vanish right before the teamfight, keep at least one player waiting between bases.
@r [분담] If the enemy abandons Waterworks and rushes your starting base, notice it immediately and help.

[분담] When a base is attacked, DPS with good mobility usually go help.
@r [위치] Even if you take an enemy base, dying respawns you at another base, making it hard to hold. Fight defensively and hold the base.
[참고] If you die across the river at Waterworks, you can respawn at the Waterworks graveyard.
[참고] Each base spawns combat buffs in rotation, and there's a speed buff on the mountain path from Mines to Waterworks.

[참고] Taking damage interrupts the capture cast, so keep hitting enemy cappers.
healer: [분담] Don't stack all three healers at one base. Split them to match enemy numbers.
[분담] If a base under attack needs healing, send one healer to help.
[위치] Break line of sight with the Waterworks building and bridges.
[참고] Since patch 12.1, healing received in battlegrounds is reduced by 20%.

[제어] In the teamfight, lock down enemies leaving to hit a base with slows and CC.
[분담] Players rotating between bases shouldn't join the teamfight until enemy stealth classes show up.

detail.overview: Arathi Basin is a resource battleground fought over five bases: Stables, Blacksmith, Gold Mine, Lumber Mill, and Farm. Holding bases generates resources, faster the more you hold. The team that holds three bases longest usually wins.

sections.title: Rules
points: [참고] Click a base's white flag to start capturing. Hold it for a set time and it becomes yours and starts generating resources.
[참고] Taking damage during the capture cast interrupts it.
[참고] More bases means faster resource gain. All bases generate the same amount.
@b [참고] In Blitz, the capture cast is 4 seconds, and the base only becomes yours if you hold it for the next 30 seconds.
@b [참고] In Blitz, a captured base gives resources for 45 seconds and can't be captured by the enemy (a shield shows on the flag). It then returns to neutral.
@b [참고] The objective frame shows each base's remaining time and the owning team's color.
@b [참고] In Blitz, resource gain per bases held is increased.

sections.title: Opening Setup
points: @r [분담] Leave one player at your starting base (Stables or Farm).
@r [분담] Send one or two to Gold Mine, and fight or hold based on how many the enemy sent.
@r [분담] If the enemy sent no one to Gold Mine, redirect the extras to Blacksmith or Lumber Mill.
@r [분담] Send two to Blacksmith to hold or cap with CC, and fight the main teamfight at Lumber Mill.
@r [분담] If you're thin on players, give up the hard-to-hold Gold Mine and send more to Blacksmith or Lumber Mill.
@b [분담] One healer goes to the center base, the other to a side base. Two or more DPS go center, and one or two cover other bases.

sections.title: Strategy
points: [분담] Don't overcommit to one base. Match enemy numbers.

detail.overview: Deepwind Gorge is a five-base resource battleground rebuilt in patch 8.3 that plays like Arathi Basin. The Market sits in the center with bases in the four corners, and the map is large, so rotating between bases takes a long time. The team that holds three bases longest usually wins.

@b [참고] In Blitz, the capture cast is 4 seconds, and the base only becomes yours if you hold it for the next 30 seconds.
@b [참고] In Blitz, a captured base gives resources for 45 seconds and can't be captured by the enemy (a shield shows on the flag). It then returns to neutral.

sections.title: Opening Setup

sections.title: Strategy

detail.overview: Cage of Carnage is a tight melee-friendly arena in a demolition dome in Undermine. Both teams drop in through trapdoors, and a metal platform across the middle separates them. The platform has ramps at its four corners, so elevation often causes line of sight issues.
